From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin occurrere (“appear, occur”), from ob + currō (“run”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /okuˈriɾ/ [o.kuˈriɾ]
  • Rhymes: -iɾ
  • Syllabification: o‧cu‧rrir

Verb

[edit]

ocurrir (third-person only, third-person singular present ocurre, third-person singular preterite ocurrió, past participle ocurrido)

  1. (impersonal) to happen, to occur
    Synonyms: pasar, suceder
  2. (idiomatic, impersonal, reflexive) to come up with
    Se me ocurrió una idea.
    I came up with an idea.
